Disappointing experience.
Mar 2023
We came her due to the previous great reviews of the “grilled goat” special and our love of local goat from previous meals in Tam Coc.

On arrival the host recommended the “grilled goat specialty” and that he would prepare enough for our table (2 adults, 2 children aged 8 & 11). We also ordered some grilled honey chicken and rice, in case our daughter wasn’t enamoured with goat meat.

What we were served was one small dish of tough, dry goat and raw onion and one small dish of tough, dry chicken and raw onion.No herbs / salads / accompaniments.

In over a month of travelling in Vietnam, this was our most disappointing meal.

Sadly would not recommend to others.
